summary: Nauru's Immigration Regulations 2014 say a visitor's visa application is made in Form 7 and must be made before entry, except by nationals of the countries covered by Regulation 16(4), who may apply on entry and pay no fee; Schedule 3 lists among them Fiji, Kiribati, Papua New Guinea, China, Israel and Thailand. Nationals of the visa waiver agreement countries in Schedule 5, which lists Russia and Spain, are exempt from the visa requirement. Form 7 asks for a police certificate and a certificate of medical fitness.

passportValidity.text: The UK government says your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the date you arrive in Nauru. Nauru's Immigration Regulations 2014 say a visa applicant's passport must not be due to expire within 3 months after the date of the application.

source.name: UK Foreign, Commonwealth & Development Office — Nauru entry requirements

alsoStatedOn.name: RONLAW — Immigration Regulations 2014, Form 7 (Application for Visitor's Visa)

source.name: US Department of State — Nauru international travel information

travelInsurance.text: No official source we could read states whether travel insurance is required to enter Nauru. The UK Foreign Office advises checking before you travel that you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.

source.name: UK FCDO travel advice — Nauru health

onwardTicket.text: Under Nauru's Immigration Regulations 2014, a visitor's visa may only be granted to a person who holds a valid ticket for travel from Nauru to another country and any documents necessary for entering the country of destination (regulation 12(1)(a)), so visa applicants are required to hold one. The Government of Canada's travel advice says customs officials may ask to see a return or onward ticket.

source.name: Immigration Act 2014 and Immigration Regulations 2014 (RONLAW, Republic of Nauru Online Legal Database)

alsoStatedOn.name: Government of Canada — Nauru travel advice

proofOfFunds.text: Under Nauru's Immigration Act, a person without sufficient lawful means of support for themselves and their dependants can be declared a prohibited immigrant, and the Immigration Regulations 2014 require a visitor's visa applicant to show means of support if asked (regulation 12(1)(c)). Canada's travel advice says customs officials may ask for proof of sufficient funds to cover your stay.

source.name: Immigration Act 2014 and Immigration Regulations 2014 (RONLAW, Republic of Nauru Online Legal Database)

alsoStatedOn.name: Government of Canada — Nauru travel advice

declarations.name: Nauru arrival card
declarations.submitWindow: Completed on the aircraft or at Nauru International Airport on arrival
declarations.text: Nauru's Immigration Regulations 2014 say a person arriving in Nauru shall complete an arrival card, sign a declaration on it that the information is correct and give it to an immigration officer when requested; the card asks for details including names, passport number and expiry date, nationality and flight number.

source.name: Immigration Act 2014 and Immigration Regulations 2014 (RONLAW, Republic of Nauru Online Legal Database)

currencyLimits.text: The US Department of State lists currency restrictions for entry as unlimited if declared on arrival, and for exit up to AUD 2,500, with a permit required for larger amounts.

source.name: US Department of State — Nauru international travel information

notes: The UK FCDO says there are controls on taking plants or animals into Nauru.

overstay.text: A person who remains in Nauru after their visa expires is an overstayer and must pay an overstayer fee of $50 for every day after expiry; the Act does not name the currency. A person who overstays by more than 7 days may not re-enter Nauru, except on a special purpose visa, within 6 months after the visa expired, unless the Minister directs otherwise.

source.name: RONLAW (Republic of Nauru Law) — Immigration Act 2014 and Immigration Regulations 2014
source.instrument: Immigration Act 2014, s 10(6), s 11(1)(d), Schedule 2; Immigration Regulations 2014, reg 19(4)

payments.text: The UK FCDO says credit cards are not accepted and there is only one ATM on the island, at the Menen Hotel, which is often out of cash, and to take enough Australian dollars in cash to cover your trip.

safety.text: The Government of Canada says the crime rate is low, though petty crime such as pickpocketing and purse snatching may occur, that tourist facilities are extremely limited, that medical facilities are limited, that lifeguards don't usually supervise beaches and riptides are common, and that there are no taxis or public transportation.

driving.text: Nauru's Motor Traffic Act 2014 (s. 30) says a valid foreign driver’s licence is accepted in place of a Nauru licence, for the vehicles and on the conditions it was issued for, for 1 month from the holder’s date of entry into Nauru; this applies only to a holder who usually resides outside Nauru and is temporarily in Nauru. The licence must be carried while driving and produced to the police on request. The Act (s. 81) sets the blood-alcohol limit at 50 milligrams of alcohol per 100 millilitres of blood. No official source we could read states whether an International Driving Permit is required.

tips.text: Nauru's Immigration Regulations 2014 say a visitor's visa application must be made before entry unless the applicant is a national of a country covered by Regulation 16(4). No official source we could read states a processing time.
The UK FCDO says credit cards are not accepted, that the island's only ATM, at the Menen Hotel, is often out of cash, and to take enough Australian dollars in cash to cover your trip.
The visitor's visa application form asks for your proposed residential address in Nauru.

faq.question: Do I need a visa for Nauru?
faq.answer: Yes, unless one of the exceptions below applies. The UK, Canadian and US governments say their citizens need a visa. Nauru's Immigration Regulations 2014 say a visitor's visa application must be made before entry, in Form 7, lodged with the immigration office in person, through a representative or online. The exceptions: nationals of the countries in Schedule 3, among them Fiji, Kiribati, the Marshall Islands, Micronesia, Palau, Papua New Guinea, Samoa, the Solomon Islands, Tonga, Tuvalu, Vanuatu, China, Israel and Thailand, may apply on entry and pay no fee, and nationals of the visa waiver agreement countries in Schedule 5, which lists Russia and Spain, are exempt from the visa requirement.

faq.question: How do I apply for a Nauru tourist visa?
faq.answer: Use Form 7 of the Immigration Regulations 2014 (the visitor's visa application) and attach certified copies of your passport's identity pages, a passport photo, a police certificate covering where you lived in the previous 12 months and a certificate of medical fitness; citizens of Australia and New Zealand also need a sponsor letter. Lodge it with the immigration office in person, through a representative or online. Payment must accompany the application unless you are exempt. No official source we could read states a processing time. The form lists the fee as $50 for up to one month, $150 for up to two months and $250 for up to three months, without naming the currency.

faq.question: How long can I stay in Nauru?
faq.answer: Nauru's Immigration Regulations 2014 say a visitor's visa may be granted for a period not exceeding 3 months and for a single entry only, and list a fee that rises with the length: $50 for up to one month, $150 for up to two and $250 for up to three, without naming the currency. No official source we could read states whether a visitor's visa can be extended.

faq.question: What currency does Nauru use and can I pay by card?
faq.answer: Canada's travel advice says the currency is the Australian dollar. The UK FCDO says credit cards are not accepted and there is only one ATM, at the Menen Hotel, which is often out of cash, and to take enough Australian dollars in cash to cover your trip.

faq.question: Is Nauru safe for visitors?
faq.answer: The Government of Canada says the crime rate is low, though petty crime such as pickpocketing may occur, and that tourist facilities are extremely limited. The UK FCDO says medical facilities are very basic and you may need medical evacuation to Australia by air ambulance, and to check you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.

levies.departure-tax.text: 3 Departure Tax Subject to exemptions in Regulation 4, every passenger departing from Nauru on an aircraft shall pay, before boarding the aircraft, a departure tax of A$50.

4 Exemptions The following persons shall be exempt from the payment of the departure tax imposed by these Regulations: (a) a child under the age of 12 years; (b) a transit passenger; (c) an aircrew member operating the aircraft departing from Nauru, or travelling on the aircraft in the course of his or her employment for the purposes of operating an aircraft; (d) a person travelling on a diplomatic passport; and (e) such other persons as the Minister may from time to time by order in writing specify, or as the Government may specify in an agreement with another Government.
(1) The Corporation may collect the departure tax from a passenger by the addition of the departure tax as a separate charge added to the price of a ticket.
